comment: Committed defaults for worker assignment per pipeline node; settings.json in the app's userData folder overrides these (edit via the in-app Settings panel). Providers: 'mock' (no API key needed), 'anthropic' (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), 'openrouter' (key saved via Settings). categoryWorkers (new) are used by advanced planning flows when a node declares a category (see FLOW_NODES.md).
